verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a context or instructions file where developers describe codebase conventions for agents to use when planning or coding. `.humanlayer/workspace.json` is a configuration file for repositories, worktrees, and setup commands, not a conventions context file, so it is only an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code
